entities.summary: The Kamioka Gravitational Wave Detector (KAGRA) is a large-scale physics experiment designed to detect gravitational waves predicted by the general theory of relativity. It is located underground at the Kamioka Observatory which is near the Kamioka section of the city of Hida in Gifu Prefecture, Japan. KAGRA is a Michelson interferometer with 3-km arm length and is designed to eventually be able to observe gravitational wave signatures from binary neutron star mergers at a distance of up to ~150 Mpc.
